option.name: Synth
option.description: Inspect and adjust the current synth patch

suboption.name: State
suboption.description: Show current synth patch, audio status, and aggregate pressed-note state

suboption.name: Params
suboption.description: List safe synth parameters, ranges, units, and built-in presets

suboption.name: Set
suboption.description: Set one synth parameter to a normalized value

suboption.name: Patch
suboption.description: Apply multiple normalized synth parameter values

suboption.name: Apply
suboption.description: Apply a named built-in or user synth preset

suboption.name: Save
suboption.description: Save the current synth patch as a user preset

option.name: Coach
option.description: Learn, replay, attempt, and review saved MIDI lessons

suboption.name: Teach
suboption.usage: /coach teach QUERY [--segment LABEL --tempo 25..200 --difficulty foundation|standard|challenge --hand left|right|both --loops 1..8 --author never|bounded]
suboption.description: Reuse a saved lesson or author one local bounded approximation for a named segment, then demonstrate, capture, and score it; --author never is cache-only

suboption.name: Replay
suboption.description: Replay the active saved lesson without authoring or overwriting it

suboption.name: Attempt
suboption.description: Capture and score a fresh human-only attempt against the active lesson

suboption.name: Feedback
suboption.description: End an active capture early or retrieve one bounded deterministic report

suboption.name: State
suboption.description: Read the bounded coach phase, lesson settings, progress, and latest aggregate report

suboption.name: Stop
suboption.description: Cancel coach work and release only Halcyon-owned voices for its session
